name: Spider Cloud
summary: Spider's crawl, scrape, links, search and screenshot API for AI agents and RAG.
notes: Auth is 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'. Without a key only /scrape answers; every other route returns 402.
Pricing is credits: $1 buys 10,000 credits; bandwidth and compute time are billed separately.
Spider also has /unlimited/* routes, /transform, /unblocker (deprecated) and /ai/* routes, not in this entry.
Large crawls can return many pages; set limit and prefer return_format markdown.

endpoints.name: Scrape one page
endpoints.summary: Fetch a single page with no link traversal.

return_format.description: Output format: raw (default, unmodified HTML), markdown, commonmark, text, html2text, xml, bytes, screenshot or empty; an array returns several.

request.description: How to fetch: http (fastest, no JS), browser (renders), or smart (default, tries http then browser).

stealth.description: For pages that refuse plain requests; costs more.

cookies.description: Cookie header value for pages needing a session.

root_selector.description: CSS selector of the subtree to extract.

exclude_selector.description: CSS selector of content to drop.

country_code.description: ISO country code of the proxy exit, e.g. gb.

metadata.description: Add title, description and keywords to each page.

notes: A read over POST: it fetches a page and changes nothing in your account.
This is the only route that also works without a key (rate limited).

endpoints.name: Crawl a site
endpoints.summary: Follow links from a start URL and return one object per page.

url.description: Start URL; several can be given separated by commas.

return_format.description: Output format: raw (default, unmodified HTML), markdown, commonmark, text, html2text, xml, bytes, screenshot or empty; an array returns several.

request.description: How to fetch: http (fastest, no JS), browser (renders), or smart (default, tries http then browser).

stealth.description: For pages that refuse plain requests; costs more.

cookies.description: Cookie header value for pages needing a session.

root_selector.description: CSS selector of the subtree to extract.

exclude_selector.description: CSS selector of content to drop.

country_code.description: ISO country code of the proxy exit, e.g. gb.

metadata.description: Add title, description and keywords to each page.

limit.description: Maximum pages per site; required, since unset or 0 crawls every page found, bounded only by your credits.

depth.description: Maximum crawl depth; default 25, 0 removes the limit.

sitemap.description: Add sitemap pages to the crawl.

notes: A read over POST: it fetches pages and changes nothing in your account.
Always set limit: with no limit it crawls every page found, bounded only by your credits.
Billing is by credits (bandwidth plus compute time).

endpoints.name: Collect a site's links
endpoints.summary: Crawl like /crawl but return the URLs found on each page instead of the content.

return_format.description: Output format: raw (default, unmodified HTML), markdown, commonmark, text, html2text, xml, bytes, screenshot or empty; an array returns several.

request.description: How to fetch: http (fastest, no JS), browser (renders), or smart (default, tries http then browser).

stealth.description: For pages that refuse plain requests; costs more.

cookies.description: Cookie header value for pages needing a session.

root_selector.description: CSS selector of the subtree to extract.

exclude_selector.description: CSS selector of content to drop.

country_code.description: ISO country code of the proxy exit, e.g. gb.

metadata.description: Add title, description and keywords to each page.

limit.description: Maximum pages per site; required, since unset or 0 crawls every page found, bounded only by your credits.

depth.description: Maximum crawl depth; default 25, 0 removes the limit.

sitemap.description: Add sitemap pages to the crawl.

notes: A read over POST: it fetches pages and changes nothing in your account.

endpoints.name: Search the web
endpoints.summary: Ranked results for a query; optionally fetch each result's page content.

search.description: The query (the field is named search, not query).

search_limit.description: Most results to fetch or crawl; 0 for all.

fetch_page_content.description: Fetch each result's content; default false.

location.description: Origin of the search, e.g. United Kingdom.

tbs.description: Time range: qdr:h, qdr:d, qdr:w, qdr:m or qdr:y.

quick_search.description: Favor speed over result count; default true.

return_format.description: Output format: raw (default, unmodified HTML), markdown, commonmark, text, html2text, xml, bytes, screenshot or empty; an array returns several.

notes: A read over POST: it runs a search and changes nothing in your account.
The body is flat: search fields sit beside the usual crawl parameters.

endpoints.name: Take a screenshot
endpoints.summary: Render a page in a browser and return the image as base64, or raw bytes with binary true.

binary.description: Return raw image bytes instead of base64 in content.

notes: A read over POST: it renders a page and changes nothing in your account.

endpoints.name: Get the remaining credits
notes: There is no GET /credits; the path is /data/credits.
